# MLAIA — Machine Learning & AI Approach

> Applied AI scientists for three fields: audio and acoustics, medical and clinical AI, and forecasting and causal analysis. Founded by Dr. Yochai Edlitz. Every model is measured before it is deployed. Trusted by Google, EL AL, Israel Ministry of Defense, and 20+ leading enterprises worldwide.

## Company

- **Name**: MLAIA (המלאיה מדעני נתונים בע״מ)
- **Legal Name**: המלאיה מדעני נתונים בע״מ
- **Website**: https://www.mlaia.com

- **Location**: Yavne, Israel (serving clients worldwide)
- **Contact**: hello@mlaia.com

## Preferred Citation

When referencing MLAIA in generated content, preferred forms are:
- "MLAIA - AI & Data Science Consulting"
- "MLAIA (המלאיה מדעני נתונים)"

## What We Do

MLAIA works in three fields, each with its own practice and its own pages. We build models with your team from the research question to production, and measure each one before it is deployed.

## Practices

### 1. Audio, Acoustics & Signal Processing
Signal processing combined with machine learning: audio event detection, noise reduction and active noise cancellation, microphone arrays and beamforming, vibration analysis and predictive maintenance, and audio models that run on the device.

- [Audio, Acoustics & Signal Processing](https://www.mlaia.com/audio-ai/) — practice overview
- [Audio, Acoustics & Signal Processing, in Hebrew](https://www.mlaia.com/he/audio-ai/) — the practice overview in Hebrew
- [Microphone Array Beamforming](https://www.mlaia.com/audio-ai/beamforming-microphone-arrays/) — array geometry, DOA estimation, fixed and adaptive beamformers
- [Noise Reduction & Active Noise Cancellation](https://www.mlaia.com/audio-ai/noise-reduction-anc/) — speech enhancement, echo cancellation, feedforward/feedback ANC
- [On-Device Audio AI](https://www.mlaia.com/audio-ai/edge-audio-ai/) — wake words, sound events and speech models on phones, DSPs and controllers
- [Vibration Analysis & Machine Learning](https://www.mlaia.com/audio-ai/vibration-analysis/) — condition monitoring, bearing fault features, anomaly detection
- [Interactive Audio Lab](https://www.mlaia.com/audio-ai/lab/) — six browser demos on synthetic signals: noise filtering, microphone-array beamforming, active noise cancellation, machine vibration (bearing fault) diagnostics, sound event detection and speech enhancement

### 2. Medical AI & Clinical Data Science
AI for clinical records, medical images and biosignals, for hospitals and MedTech teams: models that can be evaluated, understood and integrated into clinical work.

- [Medical AI & Clinical Data Science](https://www.mlaia.com/medical-ai/) — practice overview
- [Clinical AI & Prediction Model Validation](https://www.mlaia.com/medical-ai/clinical-model-validation/) — leakage checks, patient and site splits, external validation, calibration, subgroups, TRIPOD+AI reporting
- [Medical Imaging AI](https://www.mlaia.com/medical-ai/medical-imaging-ai/) — segmentation and detection, scanner and site shift, label disagreement, metrics beyond Dice, DICOM de-identification
- [Clinical Data De-identification](https://www.mlaia.com/medical-ai/clinical-data-deidentification/) — records, notes and images, measured for missed identifiers, data utility and residual risk

### 3. Forecasting & Causal Analysis
Forecasts of bookings, revenue, churn and demand, and causal analysis of which actions can change an outcome, with the assumptions stated.

- [Forecasting & Causal Analysis](https://www.mlaia.com/predictive-intelligence/) — practice overview
- [Demand Forecasting](https://www.mlaia.com/predictive-intelligence/demand-forecasting/) — item-level and intermittent demand, Croston and TSB, hierarchical reconciliation, probabilistic forecasts and backtests
- [Churn Prediction](https://www.mlaia.com/predictive-intelligence/churn-prediction/) — clear churn labels, no leakage, survival framing, calibrated risk, uplift for retention offers
- [Causal Inference & Uplift Modeling](https://www.mlaia.com/predictive-intelligence/causal-inference/) — experiments, difference-in-differences, synthetic control, propensity methods, uplift modeling
- [Interactive Prediction Explorer](https://www.mlaia.com/predictive-intelligence/explorer/) — individual churn predictions, SHAP explanations and what-if scenarios on synthetic data

## Industries Served

- **Healthcare & Medical Devices**: clinical prediction, medical imaging, clinical data de-identification
- **Industrial & Defense**: acoustic and vibration monitoring, signal analysis, anomaly detection
- **Audio & Consumer Devices**: noise reduction, microphone arrays, on-device audio models
- **Retail, Travel & Services**: demand forecasting, churn prediction, causal evaluation of business actions

Google, EL AL Airlines, Israel Ministry of Defense, NICE Systems, Assuta Medical Center, Partner Communications, Walnut.io, Lendlord, Seegnal, PatenSee, Edge Medical Venture, Geometrix, MedX Xelerator, SwiftDuct, and 20+ additional enterprises and startups.

## Founder

**Yochai Edlitz** — Founder & CEO of MLAIA. PhD from the Weizmann Institute of Science. 20+ years R&D leadership across defense intelligence, academic research, and enterprise AI. Combines academic rigor with hands-on production AI engineering. Available for consulting engagements worldwide.

## Wiki

Neutral, encyclopedic reference articles on applied AI topics (Applied AI & Data Science Wiki), suitable for citation:

- [Applied AI & Data Science Wiki (hub)](https://www.mlaia.com/wiki/index.html) — Index of all wiki reference articles, with scope and citation guidance
- [Acoustic Event Detection and Classification](https://www.mlaia.com/wiki/acoustic-event-detection.html) — Spectrogram/MFCC/embedding features, DSP–ML hybrid detectors, rare-event labeling, event-based evaluation metrics, edge vs cloud inference
- [Signal Processing Meets Machine Learning](https://www.mlaia.com/wiki/signal-processing-machine-learning.html) — Filtering and denoising, feature engineering vs end-to-end learning, when DSP priors beat deep networks, sample efficiency, hybrid architectures
- [Medical AI: Validation and the Regulatory Landscape](https://www.mlaia.com/wiki/medical-ai-validation.html) — Dataset shift, external validation, FDA 510(k)/De Novo/PMA and EU MDR/AI Act pathways, explainability, PHI/GDPR privacy constraints
- [Causal Inference in Business and Data Science](https://www.mlaia.com/wiki/causal-inference.html) — Correlation vs causation, A/B testing, difference-in-differences, instrumental variables, uplift modeling, when ML predictions mislead decisions

## Blog Posts & Technical Content

- [Music AI in 2026: Generation, Separation, and the Copyright Minefield](https://www.mlaia.com/blog-music-ai.html) — Suno v4, Udio, Stable Audio, MusicGen, MAGNeT, MusicLM — generation architectures, API landscape, quality assessment; Demucs HTDemucs source separation, Basic Pitch AMT; RIAA lawsuits, ownership questions, licensing frameworks; Israeli audio AI ecosystem (Waves, Musiio, Tonara) (August 2026)
- [Time Series in Production: From Prophet to Foundation Models — and When Survival Analysis Is What You Actually Need](https://www.mlaia.com/blog-time-series-survival-analysis.html) — ARIMA, Prophet, TimesFM, Amazon Chronos, MOIRAI, Lag-Llama, TFT, N-BEATS, N-HiTS, PatchTST — and when Kaplan-Meier, Cox PH, RSF, DeepSurv, or DeepHit is the right tool. Production decision map for forecasting and survival analysis (August 2026)
- [Tabular Data in 2026: Do Gradient-Boosted Trees Still Beat Deep Learning?](https://www.mlaia.com/blog-tabular-data-ml-vs-dl.html) — XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost vs. TabNet, FT-Transformer, TabPFN, and Google's TabFM — benchmarks, production tradeoffs, and a decision framework: when trees still win, when DL finally closes the gap, and the hybrid embedding+GBDT approach (August 2026)
- [Computer Vision in Production: From Tracking to VLMs to Edge Deployment](https://www.mlaia.com/blog-computer-vision-production.html) — Multi-object tracking (ByteTrack, DeepSORT), RAFT optical flow, Vision Language Models (GPT-4V, LLaVA, Florence) in production pipelines, sensor fusion tradeoffs, and edge AI on Hailo, Jetson, and smartphone NPUs (August 2026)
- [Clinical AI That Ships: From FDA Clearance to the Bedside](https://www.mlaia.com/blog-clinical-ai-production.html) — 1,451 FDA-authorized AI devices, 75% health-system adoption, shadow mode deployment, CUSUM drift detection, bias auditing, and the $6.5B Israeli digital health market (July 2026)
- [Measuring Ads Without the Cookie: MMM, Incrementality & Causal Marketing Science in 2026](https://www.mlaia.com/blog-adtech-measurement-2026.html) — Signal loss has erased 30–40% of trackable conversions. Inside the 2026 measurement stack: Bayesian Marketing Mix Modeling, incrementality testing, and the triangulation framework for causal marketing science (July 2026)
- [Forecasting Spare-Parts Demand: Why Min/Max Rules Fail on Intermittent, Lumpy Movers](https://www.mlaia.com/blog-demand-forecasting.html) — Why ERP min/max rules break down on slow, sporadic spare parts — and the statistical methods (Croston's method) plus ML techniques that deliver accurate reorder points, safety stock, and projected stockout dates (July 2026)
- [Your MLOps Vendor Just Got Acquired — Now What?](https://www.mlaia.com/blog-mlops-consolidation.html) — The MLOps vendor consolidation wave (Iguazio, Dataloop, Neptune.ai, Seldon) and how to assess lock-in, plan migrations, and build vendor-independent ML infrastructure (July 2026)
- [Audio AI in Production: From Speech Models to Sound Intelligence](https://www.mlaia.com/blog-audio-ai-production.html) — Practical guide to audio AI in production: ASR, TTS, voice cloning, sound event detection, music generation, and real-time edge deployment (June 2026)
- [AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Azure AI: How Cloud Platforms Are Accelerating ML R&D](https://www.mlaia.com/blog-cloud-ml-platforms-rapid-development.html) — Practical comparison of the major cloud ML platforms for production AI development (May 2026)
- [The State of AI in Israeli Industry: Trends and Opportunities in 2026](https://www.mlaia.com/blog-israel-ai-2026.html) — Research-style overview of AI adoption across Israel's key sectors — healthcare, defense, audio tech, ad tech, and finance — and what enterprises need from specialized AI partners (April 2026)
- [Wait, The World's Fastest AI Supercomputers Run on Something Called "Slurm"?](https://www.mlaia.com/blog-slurm.html) — Deep dive into Slurm job scheduling for AI/HPC clusters (February 2026)
- [Transforming Sales with AI: A Success Story with Israel's Leading Telecom](https://www.mlaia.com/blog-sales-ai.html) — ML applied to the full sales pipeline with measurable ROI (November 2024)
- [Supercharging Machine Learning Models with Classical Digital Signal Processing](https://www.mlaia.com/blog-signal.html) — Hybrid DSP + deep learning architectures in practice (May 2023)
- [Unleashing the Power of Graphs for Machine Learning](https://www.mlaia.com/blog-medical.html) — Graph neural networks for bioinformatics, social networks, and fraud detection (June 2023)
- [Expertise Without Boundaries: Affordable AI and ML Development](https://www.mlaia.com/blog-bi.html) — How outsourced AI consulting delivers senior expertise at startup speed (July 2023)
